Ecolab Company has an opening for Financial Planning Analyst. If you are a passionate professional that is seeking opportunity, advancement, and a rewarding career we invite you to apply. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a highly recognized global growth company offering competitive compensation and benefits in addition to career growth.

The Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst will be responsible for financial planning and analysis activities of Ecolab divisional sales. This position will require partnership across multiple stakeholders within the organization and will have significant exposure and growth opportunities supported by a management team committed to associate development.

What You Will Do:

· Analyze trends for Ecolab divisions, including volume and pricing and provide insights to the divisional teams on Key performance metrics

· Coordinate monthly close and forecast activities, including communicating guidance, facilitating system loads, analyzing results Salles/ Gross profit & SG&A ), and preparing content for financial reviews with senior leadership

· Perform Operation income reconciliation from Forecast to Actuals

· Prepare Daily sales variance vs forecast to arrive at month end finish estimates Vs forecast

· Primary owner of developing a driver-based 50/50 forecast

· Partner with division finance teams to understand external and internal business dynamics and their impact on results

· Lead the creation of annual plan by leveraging the trend based analytical model to arrive at a high-level proposal & coordinate/communicate with multiple key stakeholders

· Develop sustainable content for use in monthly business reviews (MBRs) and provide ad-hoc financial analytics and deep dives to facilitate decision making

· Partner with broader stakeholders to drive critical reporting needs and capabilities

Minimum Qualifications:

· Chartered Accountant /MBA premier business school

· 5 plus years of experience in financial Planning & Analysis

Preferred Qualifications:

· Financial planning and analysis experience

· Ability to translate financial analysis into insights and action plans

· Ability to identify key metrics critical to business performance and provide easily understood and actionable management reporting

· Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills

· Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact with senior management

· Strong presentation skills to communicate complex financial and performance information with a variety of audiences, including those with limited finance background

· Self-motivated with ability to efficiently organize and prioritize competing priorities

· Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to develop, implement and interpret financial models

· Strong PC and systems skills (Power BI, Microsoft Excel, Access, and PowerPoint) Excel, Access and PowerPoint)

Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging
Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

About the Opportunity

• DDE ULTRA is a pioneering provider of ultra-high purity process utility systems serving the semiconductor, PV Solar and other high-tech industries. We specialize in designing, manufacturing and installing complex utility systems and turnkey solutions.
• We are seeking an Experienced Chartered Accountant (CA) to independently lead the complete Finance & Accounts function, ensuring financial control, compliance, accurate reporting, effective cost management and sound financial decision-making.

Role & Responsibilities

• Take end-to-end ownership of accounting, finance operations, monthly and annual book closures, and finalization of accounts.
• Prepare and review financial statements, cash-flow reports, MIS and management dashboards, present key financial insights to senior management.
• Lead annual budgeting, periodic budget forecasting and financial planning across departments and projects.
• Conduct budget-versus-actual variance analysis, investigate deviations and recommend corrective actions.
• Manage cost control and optimization, including project costs, material, manpower, overheads and operating expenses; monitor cost overruns and profitability.
• Oversee cash flow, working capital, fund planning, receivables, payables, banking relationships and facilities such as BGs and LCs, wherever applicable.
• Manage direct and indirect taxation, including GST, TDS and income tax, ensuring timely filings, reconciliations and resolution of notices.
• Lead statutory, internal and tax audits; coordinate with auditors and consultants and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
• Oversee project accounting, project-wise costing, billing, revenue recognition, work-in-progress, retention and profitability reporting.
• Establish and strengthen financial policies, internal controls, approval mechanisms, accounting procedures and compliance calendars.
• Lead and guide the Accounts & Finance team, review deliverables and ensure timely and accurate completion of activities.
• Coordinate with projects, procurement, stores, HR, sales and other teams on budgets, costs, collections, payments and financial matters.

Skills & Qualifications

Must-Have

• Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
• 10–15 years of relevant post-qualification experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably in engineering, manufacturing, EPC or project-based organizations.
• Demonstrated ability to independently manage the complete finance function, including accounting, taxation, audits, banking and statutory compliance.
• Proven experience in annual budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, cost control and project profitability management.
• Experience in financial reporting, cash-flow and working-capital management, internal controls and team leadership.
• Strong analytical, decision-making, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with high integrity and accountability.

Preferred

• Engineering, manufacturing and industrial organizations.
• Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) companies.
• Project-based engineering, infrastructure and turnkey solution providers.
• Semiconductor, PV Solar, process engineering and industrial utility industries.

Benefits & Culture Highlights

• This is a senior-level role with independent ownership of the organization's Finance & Accounts function.
• The candidate must combine hands-on financial management with leadership-level planning, reporting and decision support.
• Experience in managing finance for a growing engineering, manufacturing or EPC business will be an advantage.

Role Purpose

• Act as a strategic finance partner to the Country CFO and other India leadership team, providing insight, challenge, and forward-looking decision support
• Build and scale a robust FP&A and performance management platform suited to a fast-growing, multi-entity renewable energy business
• Strengthen financial predictability, investment discipline, and management visibility across a complex operating environment
• Support timely and well-informed decision-making by connecting operational performance, financial outcomes, and market dynamics

Profile & Experience

• 12–15+ years of experience in FP&A, performance management, or strategic finance roles within complex organizations.
• Gender Diversity Hiring role
• Strong experience in multi-entity environments, ideally including SPVs, infrastructure, project-based businesses, or asset-heavy sectors
• Proven exposure to investment analysis, business cases, M&A, or structured financing topics
• Track record in finance transformation, including ERP, data, reporting, or process improvement initiatives
• Exposure to renewable energy, infrastructure, or energy markets would be a strong advantage
• Fluent in English, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with senior stakeholders in an international environment; French would be a plus

Key Interfaces & Exposure

• Country CFO and India leadership team
• Regional and Group finance stakeholders, including QBRs and other performance review forums
• Construction, Operations, Business Development, and other key business functions
• Accounting, Tax, Treasury, and other finance teams involved in planning, reporting, and investment reviews

Strategic & Transformation Responsibilities

• Build a scalable FP&A framework to support growth, multi-SPV complexity, and business decision-making
• Strengthen performance management tools, reporting frameworks, and management dashboards
• Improve data quality, reporting consistency, and finance processes across the organization
• Support finance transformation linked to ERP deployment, automation, and process simplification

Operational Performance & Governance

• Lead monthly and quarterly performance reviews, with clear reporting on actuals, deviations, risks, and actions
• Ensure timely capture and consolidation of key business inputs affecting forecast accuracy, including construction timelines, commissioning dates, regulatory and legal developments, and O&M performance actions
• Maintain an updated best estimate through regular challenge of assumptions with Construction, Operations, Business Development, and other key stakeholders
• Lead the annual budget, forecast, and reforecast processes, with clear assumptions, cross-functional alignment, and accountability for delivery
• Review investment files and challenge key business assumptions to assess their impact on project KPIs, strengthen decision quality, and support robust and competitive bids
• Ensure strong governance over performance reporting, key assumptions, and follow-up of action plans

Skills & Leadership

• Ability to build clear executive-level storytelling, translating complex financial and business topics into concise insights and decision-oriented messages
• Strong financial modelling, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities
• Solid understanding of financial reporting, consolidation principles, and performance drivers
• Comfort with data, systems, and BI tools, with the ability to translate complexity into clear management insight
• Ability to combine strategic perspective with operational discipline in a fast-evolving environment
• Strong leadership presence, ownership, and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to influence senior decisionmakers and lead, develop, and progressively strengthen a small FP&A team as the function evolves

Why this role matters

• Play a central role in scaling one of ENGIE’s key renewable growth platforms in a high-potential market
• Shape how performance is measured, understood, and steered in a business undergoing rapid growth and transformation
• Work in close proximity to senior leadership on topics that directly influence investment decisions, business performance, and value creation
• Take on a visible and high-impact role at the intersection of finance, strategy, operations, and market dynamics

Wolters Kluweris a global leader in professional information services, providing software and content solutions for legal, business, tax, accounting, finance, audit, risk, compliance, and healthcare professionals. Serving clients in over 180 countries with operations in 40+, the company helps professionals make confident decisions and drive results. Headquartered in Alphen aan den Rijn, the Netherlands, it employs around 21,000 people worldwide.
The Global Finance Shared Services (FSS) is a finance function designed to bring together finance and accounting professionals to streamline and enhance processes and tools. Within FSS, the Finance Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Pune, India, provides centralized financial and analytical support across all Wolters Kluwer divisions. The team, comprising finance professionals and data scientists, focuses on finance reporting harmonization, technology enablement, and reporting and analytics enhancements.
In this senior individual-contributor role, you will independently lead key financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and controlling activities for the Financial Shared Services (FSS) team. You will act as a trusted finance partner to business and finance leaders, converting complex financial and operational data into actionable insights, challenging assumptions, identifying risks and opportunities, and driving process and control improvements. The role requires ownership of recurring deliverables, coordination across entities and functions, and high-quality communication with senior stakeholders.

Reports To : Manager/Associate Director, Finance COE
Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or data analytics, with relevant experience in FP&A, controlling, accounting, or consulting.
Master's degree/MBA in finance or a professional qualification such as CPA, CMA, CA, or equivalent.
Experience :
Progressive experience in FP&A, financial controlling, accounting, or business finance, preferably supporting technology, shared-services, or multinational organizations.
Experience partnering with senior finance and business stakeholders, reviewing complex analyses, and influencing actions through data-driven recommendations.
Experience improving financial processes, internal controls, reporting governance, or automation is strongly preferred.
Strong analytical capability with experience handling large datasets and translating financial and operational data into actionable insights.
Advanced Excel and Microsoft Office skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas (IF, VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS), macros, and exposure to SQL or Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications (VBA).
Proficient in financial analysis, forecasting, business-performance modeling, KPI reporting, and decision support across P&L, cash flow, and ad hoc analyses.
Working knowledge of ERP and reporting tools such as Entity ERP system, Tagetik, Hyperion, Microsoft Access, Power BI, or Tableau is preferred.
Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, internal controls, and management reporting knowledge of tax topics is an advantage.

Strong stakeholder-management, influencing, and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages for finance, non-finance, and senior-leadership audiences.
Flexible, reliable, quick to learn, and comfortable operating in changing or ambiguous environments.
Financial Reporting, Analysis & Controlling
Own the preparation and analysis of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results across cost centers, entities, divisions, and product levels, with a strong focus on P&L and balance-sheet accuracy, including variance analysis and commentary versus Latest Estimate (LE), Budget, and prior year.
Prepare materials for the directors of business entities, including performance reports covering revenues, costs, EBITA, and cash flow product-level revenue overviews monthly revenue and cost forecasts by source compared with actual results and budgets for revenues, costs, and cash flow by business area and product.
Prepare requirements requested by the parent company, including analyses, budgets, long-term financial strategies, and ad hoc projects.
Provide financial guidance to internal departments by translating financial and operational insights into practical business actions.
Develop and improve planning models using historical trends, operational drivers, volume metrics, and vendor data challenge assumptions, document dependencies, and quantify risks and opportunities.
Analyze revenue streams, profitability, margins, volume trends, and customer or seasonal impacts on financial performance.
Monitor profitability by individual product and communicate results to responsible product managers analyze revenues and costs for new and existing products and track their development over time with Editors-in-Chief and Project Managers and perform revenue and cost analyses based on defined requirements.
Coordinate closely with regional and divisional controlling teams, chief accountants, external accounting service providers, HR business partners, tax consultants, and auditors to ensure data accuracy, alignment, and timely issue resolution.
Fulfill reporting and compliance requirements, including tax-related obligations, for business entities toward governmental institutions within the scope of controlling activities.
Coordinate and support accounting activities and ensure the accuracy of accounting records.
Prepare documentation for auditors and support the annual financial statement audit.

Systems, Data & Process Improvement
Ensure proper cost center alignment and mapping across Workday, Entity ERP system, and Tagetik.
Support financial-system transitions, enhancements, and migrations by understanding current processes, data structures, and reporting requirements.
Provide user support for employees within the Entity ERP system information system environment.
Lead improvements in data collection, reporting, spreadsheet and model structures, internal controls, and review mechanisms to strengthen efficiency, accuracy, and governance.
Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies governing the financial management and accounting of business entities, including Wolters Kluwer rules and procedures.
Participate in, coordinate, and lead OPEX projects focused on process optimization, including cost-saving initiatives and implementation of new technologies.
Implement standardized and automated workflows and drive continuous improvement across business units.
Develop, implement, and ensure adherence to control mechanisms, internal procedures, and internal controls in business entities in line with Wolters Kluwer rules and procedures.
~ Stakeholder Management & Ad-hoc Support
Present concise, decision-oriented financial insights, recommendations, and implications to stakeholders, including senior leadership.
Provide financial analysis and decision support for potential acquisitions and divestitures, as well as ad hoc analysis across revenue, cost, profitability, cash flow, and controlling topics.
TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS Minimal travel might be required.
PHYSICAL DEMANDS Working from the Kalyani Nagar, Pune office on a hybrid schedule (Mondays and Tuesdays).

Position Senior Manager - Finance (Global GL controllership)

Work Location: Pune (All days Work from office)

Chartered Accountant (CA)
10 to 12 years of post-qualification experience in Financial Reporting, Consolidation, Controllership, and Audit

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Manager - Finance to support the Global Controllership function. The role will be responsible for monthly books close, variance analysis, US GAAP reporting, SOX compliance, and coordination with global finance teams. The candidate will play a critical role in ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting to adhere management reporting timelines.

Conduct monthly variance analysis of Profit & Loss accounts and Balance Sheet items.
Coordinate with finance teams across subsidiaries to obtain financial information and resolve reporting issues.
Participate in monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes in compliance with US GAAP requirements.
Participate in the intercompany workings related to cost plus, agency revenue, common cost allocation etc.
Review journal entries, accruals, intercompany transactions, and balance sheet reconciliations.
Perform detailed General Ledger scrutiny and ensure completeness and accuracy of accounting records.
Review and validate US GAAP adjustment workings, including:
Lease accounting
Compensated absences
Defined benefit obligations
Term loan
Other technical accounting adjustments
Support financial close activities of newly acquired entities.
Coordinate with acquired entity finance teams to ensure smooth integration into group reporting processes.
Monitor SOX controls related to financial reporting and month-end close processes.
Assist in remediation and resolution of control deficiencies, if any.
Support group auditors and management by preparing audit schedules, reconciliations, and financial analysis.
Lead and coordinate local statutory and compliance audits for subsidiaries.
Participate in finance transformation initiatives and system enhancement projects.
Contribute to strengthening the overall finance control environment.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of US GAAP/IFRS and financial consolidation principles.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and SAP/Oracle systems.
Effective stakeholder management and communication skills.
High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Work Location: Hinjewadi, Pune, Maharashtra.

Compensation: 200,000.00 - 250,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person .
